Container.Name: Lazy-AMPR
Container.Overview: Lazy_AMPR web UI: build or extract AMPR LZ4 asset packs for PS5 game folders to reduce game size. Map the share with your game folders to /games and a share for the packed result to /output, then open the web UI.

Config.Name: Games
Config.Description: Share containing your PS5 game folders (each with sce_sys/param.json). Read-only (ro) also works for packing.

Config.Name: Output
Config.Description: Where packed (<game>_AMPR) and extracted folders are written.

Config.Name: Web UI password
Config.Description: Optional. When set, the web UI asks for user name and password (HTTP basic auth).

Config.Name: Web UI user name
Config.Description: User name for the optional password.

Config.Name: Browsable folders
Config.Description: Comma-separated container paths the web UI may browse. Add more if you map additional paths.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid: 100 = users).
